trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details for the outbound call lead.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent looks up the booking details using the known lead_id before speaking to the customer.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to know the unit and booking details to contextually greet the customer on this outbound call.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer, state the call's purpose broadly, and ask for KYC verification.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent greets the customer and asks for a verification factor before disclosing sensitive booking details.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं developer office से बात कर रहा हूँ। आपकी एक pending instalment के सिलसिले में कॉल किया है। आगे बढ़ने से पहले, KYC के लिए क्या आप अपना registered name confirm कर सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: Outbound call requires establishing contact and verifying identity before discussing specific payment amounts or booking status.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent calls the verification tool with the provided registered name.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided their name, which matches one of the allowed non-sensitive knowledge factors.

steps.purpose: Share the pending payment status and current allotment state.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent confirms verification and shares the booking reference and allotment status.
steps.text: Thank you Rahul जी। आपकी booking BK-9009 के लिए next payment due है। अभी आपका allotment provisional है।
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent can now safely disclose the booking reference and its provisional status.

steps.expected_behavior: The agent re-engages without restarting the workflow or repeating the same prompt verbatim, and what was already collected survives.
steps.text: Rahul जी, क्या आप मुझे सुन पा रहे हैं? मैं आपकी pending instalment के बारे में बात कर रहा था।
steps.planner_rationale: The customer stopped responding, so the agent gently checks if they are still on the line and reminds them of the context.

steps.purpose: Ask a clarifying question and volunteer context.
steps.text: Sorry, मैं सोच रहा था कि provisional allotment का क्या मतलब है? और अगर मैं अभी cancel करूँ तो क्या होगा? मैंने 3,00,000 pay किये थे 45 days पहले।
steps.clean_text: Sorry, मैं सोच रहा था कि provisional allotment का क्या मतलब है? और अगर मैं अभी cancel करूँ तो क्या होगा? मैंने 3,00,000 pay किये थे 45 days पहले।
steps.model_visible_text: Sorry, मैं सोच रहा था कि provisional allotment का क्या मतलब है? और अगर मैं अभी cancel करूँ तो क्या होगा? मैंने 3,00,000 pay किये थे 45 days पहले।

steps.purpose: Check refund eligibility to answer the cancellation query.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent calls the refund eligibility tool before quoting any deduction or refund amounts.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked about the financial impact of cancelling, which requires the eligibility tool to calculate deductions accurately.

steps.purpose: Return refund eligibility and deduction amounts.
Explain provisional allotment and state the exact refund terms from the tool.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent answers the clarifying question and grounds all financial figures and timelines strictly in the tool output.
steps.text: Provisional allotment का मतलब है कि payment clear होने तक booking पक्की नहीं है। अगर आप cancel करते हैं, तो 45,000 का deduction होगा और 2,55,000 refund होंगे, जिसमें 14 days लगेंगे。
steps.planner_rationale: Must address the customer's question about provisional allotment while ensuring the refund quote exactly matches the tool's deduction and processing days.

steps.purpose: Restate figures, express hesitation, and commit to payment.
steps.text: अच्छा, तो 45,000 deduction होगा और 2,55,000 वापस आएगा। मुझे थोड़ा डर लग रहा था, पर ठीक है। मैं cancel नहीं करूँगा, कल payment कर दूँगा।
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, तो 45,000 deduction होगा और 2,55,000 वापस आएगा। मुझे थोड़ा डर लग रहा था, पर ठीक है। मैं cancel नहीं करूँगा, कल payment कर दूँगा।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, तो 45,000 deduction होगा और 2,55,000 वापस आएगा। मुझे थोड़ा डर लग रहा था, पर ठीक है। मैं cancel नहीं करूँगा, कल payment कर दूँगा।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the commitment and close the call.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent acknowledges the customer's decision to pay and ends the call without making unverified promises.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। Please अपना payment जल्दी complete करें ताकि आपकी booking आगे बढ़ सके। आपका दिन शुभ हो।
steps.planner_rationale: The customer has committed to paying the instalment, successfully resolving the outbound reminder intent.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer agreed to pay the pending instalment after understanding the deduction terms.
